software.description: Venture-parameterized software build. Roles scale with ask size — never a fixed 10.

roles.mandate: Author specs/contracts/PRD.md: scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, explicit non-goals. No feature creep; each story must be verifiable.
Author specs/contracts/ARCHITECTURE.md and schema.sql: data model, API surface, ADRs. Decisions must be testable and bounded.
Implement API + persistence per locked contracts. Deliver working code; every public function exercised by a test.
Implement UI consuming the locked API. No inventing endpoints; if contract is insufficient, flag drift, do not edit specs/.
Independently author and RUN the test suite against produced code. Report actual exit codes and coverage, never predicted results.
Run real scans (secret grep, dependency audit, auth review) and report tool output verbatim. No hardcoded verdicts.

commands: npm run build 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "print('client: no build step declared — UNVERIFIED')"; exit 0

design-studio.description: Akar-style design engagements. Objective where checkable, UNVERIFIED otherwise.

roles.mandate: Define concept, visual language, and art direction brief. Output must name specific deliverables and acceptance tests.
Write brand copy per art direction brief. Every claim traceable to source material.
Check contrast ratios, asset specs, file deliverables. Run real tools; report numbers.
Trend + concept brief per production spec, with target keywords and market positioning.
Produce assets per brief into work/production/ with metadata sidecar files.
Verify every asset: dimensions, file sizes, metadata completeness, pHash distinctness. Report tool output.

commands: python3 -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open('manifest.json')); assert len(m)>0, 'empty manifest'; print(len(m),'files')"

app-venture.description: Hasan's app pipeline: software roles + business lens. Discovery first, monetization explicit.

roles.mandate: Market/competitor/privacy analysis for the target app. Cite sources; separate fact from inference.
PRD with monetization model and launch criteria. Each story has acceptance criteria and a revenue/retention link.
Architecture + schema. Prefer managed/low-infra for MVP; ADR per non-obvious choice.
Backend+client implementation for MVP per locked contracts. Backend and client merged for small scopes.
Verify domain-critical content (prayer times, verse accuracy, medical, tax) against named sources. Report discrepancies verbatim.

research.description: Deep-dive analysis. Synthesis is UNVERIFIED by construction; only tool-run steps are verifiable.

roles.mandate: Gather and analyze evidence for the question. Every claim tagged fact/inference with source.
Independently re-run the cheapest decisive checks and dispute unsupported claims.
Produce the final report from analyst+verifier outputs, preserving dispute flags.

asset-management.name: asset-management
asset-management.description: Enterprise asset ledger MVP (fixed assets, depreciation, reports). Synthesized 2026-10-23 for pilot; pending human approval.

roles.mandate: Implement the asset ledger app + CLI per locked contracts (PRD.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, schema.sql). Straight-line depreciation, status transitions, reports. All logic in a single importable module + thin CLI. No network, no secrets.
Independently author and RUN a pytest suite against work/engineering/app.py. Tests cover every acceptance criterion in PRD.md section 2. Report actual exit codes; never predict results.
Verify depreciation math: write verify_depreciation.py implementing the reference table in ARCHITECTURE.md section 4, then run it against work/engineering/app.py and report discrepancies verbatim.
